questions.question: A distracted driver:

options.text: Usually follows the rules of the road.
Is a good person to follow.

questions.explanation: Distracted drivers see hazards on the road more slowly than focused drivers. Sometimes they do not see hazards at all.

questions.question: Parked delivery trucks may be hazardous because:

options.text: People rush when leaving the truck and may not check for other vehicles.
Packages often fall out of the trucks and into the road.

questions.correctAnswerText: People rush when leaving the truck and may not check for other vehicles.
questions.explanation: Parked delivery or postal trucks are dangerous because drivers may hurry and pull into traffic without warning. They may also step out suddenly without checking for other cars.

questions.question: If the drive wheels start to skid while braking, the driver should:

options.text: Steer in the opposite direction of the skid.

questions.correctAnswerText: Steer in the opposite direction of the skid.
questions.explanation: To fix a drive-wheel braking skid, first release pressure from the brake pedal so the locked wheels can roll again. Then quickly steer in the direction you want to go, then steer the opposite way to stop the skid.

questions.question: Rust around wheel nuts may mean:
questions.explanation: Rust around wheel nuts can show that the nuts are loose. If you see rust near the wheel nuts, check them before you drive.

questions.question: When driving at night, you should do all of the following, except:

options.text: Make sure your glasses are clean.

questions.explanation: Do not wear sunglasses when driving at night. If you wear glasses, keep them clean and without scratches. Be rested and alert before driving at night.

questions.question: Ice cream trucks can be hazardous to other drivers because:

options.text: Ice cream trucks must be kept cold.
Children often run toward the truck without looking for traffic.
Ice cream trucks leave trails of water and ice on the road.

questions.correctAnswerText: Children often run toward the truck without looking for traffic.
questions.explanation: Ice cream trucks are hazardous because they attract children. Children often do not notice or pay attention to other vehicles when running to or from ice cream trucks.

questions.question: A truck tractor built after March 1, 1997 must have:
questions.explanation: Truck tractors with air brakes built on or after March 1, 1997 must have an Anti-Lock Braking System (ABS).

questions.question: When using your turn signal, you should:

options.text: Signal before you start to turn.
Turn off the signal before you start to turn.
Signal only if there are vehicles in front of you.

questions.correctAnswerText: Signal before you start to turn.
questions.explanation: Always signal well before you turn. This tells other drivers what you plan to do and stops them from trying to pass you. Without a signal, drivers may think you are just slowing down or stopping.

questions.question: To prevent a trailer from rolling over while turning, you should:
questions.explanation: Trailers roll over when the driver turns too fast. Always slow down before entering turns and curves, especially when pulling a trailer.

questions.question: Hydroplaning happens most often when:

options.text: A vehicle is traveling faster than 60 mph.

questions.explanation: Hydroplaning is most likely on wet roads with low tire pressure and worn tire tread. Hydroplaning can happen at speeds as low as 30 mph if there is enough water on the road.

questions.question: When driving, rough acceleration is:
questions.explanation: Speed up smoothly and gradually. Rough acceleration can damage your engine and transmission.

questions.question: If ice forms on your side mirror:

options.text: The road surface is probably icy too.
The road surface will not be icy.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road surface is probably icy too.
questions.explanation: If your mirrors or wipers get icy while driving, expect the road to be icy as well.

questions.question: When parking, do not use the parking brake if:

options.text: There is snow on the ground.

questions.explanation: After driving down a steep hill, let your hot brakes cool before using the parking brake. Using it while hot can damage them.

questions.question: On a curve, the posted speed limit:

options.text: Can still cause large vehicles to tip over.
Is the slowest you can legally drive.

questions.correctAnswerText: Can still cause large vehicles to tip over.
questions.explanation: The posted speed limit may be safe for cars but too fast for large trucks. A truck driven at this speed on a curve could tip over.

questions.question: Hydroplaning:

options.text: Can happen with just a little water on the road.

questions.correctAnswerText: Can happen with just a little water on the road.
questions.explanation: Hydroplaning is when your tires lose grip and slide on a thin layer of water. You do not need much water for this to happen.

questions.question: ABS helps you to:
questions.explanation: Anti-Lock Braking System (ABS) prevents wheels from locking up during hard braking. Drive and brake the same way you would without ABS.

questions.question: If a tire fails, you should:
questions.explanation: Braking after a tire fails can make you lose control. Stay off the brakes until your vehicle has slowed down a lot.

questions.question: A lane change should be:
questions.explanation: Make lane changes in a slow, smooth motion.

questions.question: Black ice is:
questions.explanation: Black ice is a thin, clear layer of ice. The road shows through it and looks wet. Watch for black ice when the road looks wet but the temperature is below freezing.

questions.question: Regular vehicle inspections help ensure:
questions.explanation: The main reason to inspect your vehicle is to keep yourself and other drivers safe.
